name: Yasser Kobeissi

intro.sub: Twenty years of creative direction for events, exhibitions and the objects people take home.

lines.text: CALL ME YASSER, OR THE GUY WITH THE MARKER

about.title: about.txt
paras: I am a Creative Director in Riyadh. I draw rooms before they exist: exhibition stands, national day villages, Ramadan tents, award nights, and the trophies and boxes people carry out of them.

Twenty years ago I was a graphic designer in a bookshop. Then ten years of broadcast motion, 2D and 3D, for TV in Lebanon. Then Riyadh, and events, where a render on Monday becomes a street on Friday.
Today I lead the creative department at Sovyal Events. I still sketch everything with a marker first. If it does not work as a line, it will not work as a build.
I am told I am the loud one in the room. The work is the quiet one. Both are on purpose.
facts: 34 on this site, more in the drawer

moves: The brief, the venue, the audience, the budget. Mostly the audience.
Marker first. One page. If the page works, the room will.
Cinema 4D and Lumion. Every wall, cable and sightline before a single screw.
Production, LED, motion content, the team on site at 3am.
Doors open. I watch faces, not screens.
pokes: You are persistent. I like that.

contact.line: Tell me the date and the room. I will draw the rest.
